workflow: An error-reporting operation retains a borrowed reference to shared exception-construction state.
It invokes user-controlled construction code while that reference is still in use.
The callback removes or replaces the shared state, releasing the object formerly referenced by the operation.
The operation then uses or releases the stale reference, causing a use-after-free instead of propagating the intended parsing error.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates retained exception state
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches reentrant invalidation of a backing resource during an ongoing operation, followed by continued use without revalidation. The specific resource is exception-construction state rather than an attached handle, but the ordering and causal mechanism are the same.
